description: This file is a server-side route implementation for managing opportunities in a Django-REST API integrated frontend, handling data fetching, creation, update, deletion, line-item management, and invoice creation related to opportunities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads opportunities, options, and related data from the API, processes and transforms the data for frontend use, and handles filters, pagination, and statistics.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Contains multiple server-side actions to handle create, update, delete operations for opportunities, line items, and invoice creation.
